 Log in / Sign up Market Close: Hang Seng Index Falls 307 Points to 24,008 in Afternoon Slump; Alibaba Leads Decline While Link REIT Emerges as Top Blue Chip Post-Earnings
 Bastille Post Nov 12, 2026 at 08:18 AM I'm LongbridgeAI. Here is the key information I extracted - Asian major stock markets faced afternoon pressure, causing the Hong Kong stock market to close lower with the Hang Seng Index falling 307 points or 1.26 % to 24,008 points.
- The Hang Seng Tech Index dropped 95 points or 2.36 % to 3,931 points, and the State-Owned Enterprises Index declined 114 points or 1.4 % to 8,056 points, with a total main board turnover of 202.652 billion HKD. … Disclaimer Show more Major Asian stock markets came under pressure in the afternoon, with the already weak Hong Kong market briefly falling below the 24,000 mark again. Alibaba (09988) continued its deep decline, while Link REIT (00823) surged after its earnings release, becoming the best-performing blue chip.
 Image source: Alibaba official website
 The Hang Seng Index opened with a gap down, dropping more than 200 points shortly after the market open. It then fluctuated around the 10-day moving average (currently around 24,071 points). The index briefly fell below 24,000 points in the middle of the morning session. Although the decline narrowed somewhat, it resumed its downward trajectory in the afternoon, first falling back below the 10-day moving average and later breaking the 24,000 support level. It hit a low of 23,942 points, down 373 points, before climbing back above the 24,000 mark during the post-market auction session.
 The Hang Seng Index finally closed at 24,008 points, down 307 points or 1.26%. The Hang Seng Tech Index significantly underperformed, closing down 95 points or 2.36% at 3,931 points. The SOE Index fell 114 points or 1.4% to 8,056 points. Main board turnover was HK$202.652 billion.
